title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Trader

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about an honest trader.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a trader known for honesty.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: A customer accidentally gave the trader extra coins.
scenes.image_prompt: customer handing coins to trader cartoon

scenes.text: The trader found the customer and returned the extra money.
scenes.image_prompt: trader returning coins to customer cartoon

scenes.text: People began to trust the trader more.
scenes.image_prompt: people happily visiting trader shop cartoon

scenes.text: The trader became successful due to trust. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: successful trader smiling in shop cartoon

story: An honest trader returned extra money to a customer. His honesty built trust, bringing him success. Vikram said honesty leads to success.
